title: application_draft.updated_at maintained manually, deviating from the repo's generic-trigger convention
evidence:
From the new migration (ends after the indexes, no trigger):
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS application_draft_continue_token_key
  ON application_draft (continue_token)
  WHERE continue_token IS NOT NULL;

Convention in supabase/migrations/20260731222000_create_reference_call.sql:
-- updated_at maintained by the repo's existing generic trigger function
-- (20260409000001, ai_analysis pattern) — bump on any row modification.
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS update_reference_call_updated_at ON reference_call;
CREATE TRIGGER update_reference_call_updated_at
  BEFORE UPDATE ON reference_call
  FOR EACH ROW
  EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();
detail: Repo convention maintains updated_at via the generic update_updated_at_column() trigger (vacancy, ai_analysis, reference_call). The draft table relies on manual sets; mark_draft_resumed_by_token.sql and clear_last_link_sent.sql omit it, so updated_at silently goes stale on those writes.
recommended_fix: Add CREATE TRIGGER update_application_draft_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ... EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column() (reference_call pattern) and drop the now-redundant manual updated_at = now() sets in the three writers.
